info.title: WeatherWear API
info.description: REST API for user authentication, weather lookup, AI clothing recommendations, recommendation history, feedback, and an AI style chat assistant.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Registration and login endpoints that issue JWT access tokens.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Authenticated account lifecycle endpoints, including user data deletion.

tags.name: Weather
tags.description: Authenticated weather lookup endpoints backed by OpenWeather and a 30-minute cache.

tags.name: Recommendations
tags.description: AI outfit recommendation workflow based on weather, optional occasion, and saved user preferences.

tags.name: History
tags.description: Authenticated recommendation history retrieval and deletion.

tags.name: Feedback
tags.description: Authenticated user feedback for generated recommendations.

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: Authenticated conversational AI assistant for weather-aware style questions.

post.description: Creates a user account with role USER and returns a JWT token for immediate use.
Authenticates an existing user and returns a JWT token.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user account. Database foreign keys cascade the user's preferences, recommendation history, feedback, chat sessions, and chat messages.

204.description: Account and associated user-owned data deleted successfully. No response body is returned.

get.description: Returns the current weather for a city. The backend reuses cached weather records for 30 minutes.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name. Maximum length is 120 characters.

200.description: Current weather for the requested city.

get.description: Returns current weather for latitude and longitude. Latitude must be between -90 and 90; longitude must be between -180 and 180.

200.description: Current weather for the requested coordinates.

post.description: Generates an AI clothing recommendation using weather data, optional occasion, and the authenticated user's saved preferences. The result is stored in recommendation history.

value.recommendation: Wear a light waterproof jacket, a long-sleeve shirt, jeans, and closed shoes. Add a scarf if you are sensitive to wind.

get.description: Returns saved preferences. If the user has none, default preferences are created and returned.

post.description: Creates or overwrites the authenticated user's preference profile. Missing optional fields receive defaults or keep existing values.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's preference profile. If the profile does not exist, default preferences are created and then updated.

get.description: Returns recommendations generated by the authenticated user, ordered from newest to oldest.

delete.description: Deletes all recommendation history rows owned by the authenticated user.

204.description: History cleared successfully. No response body is returned.

get.description: Returns a single recommendation history item if it belongs to the authenticated user.

post.description: Adds feedback to one recommendation history item owned by the authenticated user. At least one of rating or non-blank comment is required.

get.description: Returns all feedback created by the authenticated user, ordered from newest to oldest.
Returns feedback for the selected recommendation history item if it belongs to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes one feedback item if it belongs to the authenticated user.

204.description: Feedback deleted successfully. No response body is returned.

post.description: Sends a message to the AI style assistant. If sessionId is omitted, a new chat session is created. If city is supplied, the prompt includes current weather for that city.

value.message: What should I wear for a long walk today?
Can you make it more business casual?

value.answer: Choose a breathable base layer, a light jacket, comfortable trousers, and shoes with grip. Carry a compact umbrella if rain is likely.

get.description: Returns chat sessions ordered by most recent update.

get.summary: Get messages from a chat session
get.description: Returns messages from one chat session if it belongs to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes a chat session if it belongs to the authenticated user.

204.description: Chat session deleted successfully. No response body is returned.

get.description: Public endpoint for checking whether the backend process is running.

bearerAuth.description: JWT returned by /auth/register or /auth/login. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

ValidationError.description: Request validation failed, a required parameter is missing, or the JSON body is malformed.

UnauthorizedError.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, or expired.

ForbiddenError.description: The authenticated user does not have permission for the requested operation.

NotFoundError.description: The requested resource was not found or does not belong to the authenticated user.

ConflictError.description: The request conflicts with existing data or database constraints.

value.message: User with email alex@example.com already exists

BadGatewayError.description: An upstream dependency such as OpenWeather or the LLM provider failed.

password.description: Plain password submitted by the client. The backend stores only a BCrypt hash.

windSpeed.description: Wind speed in meters per second.

precipitation.description: Precipitation volume from the upstream provider when available.

cached.description: True when the response came from the local weather cache.

RecommendationRequest.description: Provide either a non-blank city or both latitude and longitude.

city.description: City name used for weather lookup.

occasion.description: Optional free-text context such as work, walk, date, or sport.

recommendation.example: Wear a light waterproof jacket, jeans, and closed shoes.

recommendationText.example: Wear a light waterproof jacket and closed shoes.

FeedbackRequest.description: At least one of rating or non-blank comment is required.

sessionId.description: Existing chat session ID. Omit to start a new session.

message.example: What should I wear for a long walk today?

city.description: Optional city used to add current weather context to the prompt.

answer.example: Choose a breathable base layer, a light jacket, comfortable trousers, and shoes with grip.

content.example: What should I wear for a long walk today?
